mode.title: Mode
mode.description: screen checks people/entities and returns evidence records; filter pulls source LEIE records with provenance.

screenList.title: People / entities to screen
screenList.description: For screen mode. Each item: { "name": "JOHN SMITH" or "ACME HOME HEALTH", "npi": "1234567893" (optional valid test NPI), "state": "NC" (optional), "ref": "your-id" (optional) }. Name-only matches are normalized exact-name candidates, constrained by state when supplied, and require human review.

name.title: Name
name.description: Person or entity name. Required when NPI is omitted.

npi.title: NPI
npi.description: Optional 10-digit NPI. The Actor also validates the NPI check digit and rejects invalid values.

state.title: State
state.description: Optional two-letter state used to constrain name candidates.

ref.title: Caller reference
ref.description: Optional caller reference returned with the evidence record.

enrichNpi.title: Resolve identity with CMS NPPES
enrichNpi.description: Look up matched LEIE NPIs or a caller-supplied NPI in the official CMS registry and return explainable correlation signals. NPI status is not licensure or eligibility.

maxNpiLookups.title: Maximum CMS NPI lookups
maxNpiLookups.description: Caps NPPES calls per run. Remaining rows still receive LEIE results and show that enrichment was skipped.

includeSam.title: Also check SAM.gov active exclusions
includeSam.description: Opt in to the official GSA SAM.gov Exclusions API. Requires your own public SAM.gov API key.

samApiKey.title: SAM.gov API key
samApiKey.description: Caller-supplied SAM.gov public API key. Required only when includeSam is enabled; never returned in output.

maxSamQueries.title: Maximum SAM.gov queries
maxSamQueries.description: Caps SAM.gov calls per run to respect the official API's role-dependent rate limits.

state.title: State (filter mode)
state.description: Two-letter state code, for example TX.

specialty.title: Specialty (filter mode)
specialty.description: Substring match on specialty, such as NURSING, PHARMACY, or HOME HEALTH.

exclusionType.title: Exclusion type (filter mode)
exclusionType.description: OIG exclusion authority code, such as 1128a1 or 1128b5.

maxRecords.title: Max records (filter mode)
maxRecords.description: Caps LEIE records returned in filter mode.
